english.title: Aid / abet interference with a badger sett
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) to interfere with a badger sett by

(A)_[damaging]_
(B)_[damaging a part of]_
(C)_[destroying]_
(D)_[obstructing access to]_
(E)_[obstructing an entrance to]_
(F)_[causing a dog to enter]_
(G)_[disturbing a badger when it was occupying]_

it with intent or being reckless as to whether

(H)_[his]_
(I)_[her]_

actions would have that consequence
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 3 and 12 of the Protection of Badgers Act 1992 and section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions: Complex, see section 12ZA.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
